title: Analysis code for: An overexpression platform reveals the functional diversity of human KRAB-Zinc Finger Proteins in maintaining cellular homeostasis
description: Python code that reproduces every figure, supporting figure and statistical table in Forey et al., PLOS Genetics. Includes the PrestoBlue proliferation screen processing, RNA-seq differential-expression panels, ChIP-exo peak and repeat annotation, the pure-stdlib bigWig reader used for all coverage tracks, the AP-MS interactome and SCAN-domain enrichment analysis, and the figure builders that emit PLOS-compliant TIFF/SVG at a fixed 7.48 in sheet width.
notes: Author list and order follow the manuscript title page (ten authors). Jerome Archambeau has no ORCID. Before publishing the Zenodo record, add as related identifiers: the article DOI (relation 'isSupplementTo') once PLOS assigns it, the GEO series accession and the ProteomeXchange/PRIDE accession (relation 'isSupplementedBy'). They are omitted here rather than carried as placeholder strings.
